The '''''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruiser''' was a class of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. They were designed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to serve as second-line ships.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Characteristics==
The ''Neutron Star''-class was 600 meters long. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the design had become outdated and easily challenged and outgunned by most up-to-date capital ships. It was slow in comparison with many of its counterparts, as well as prone to frequent damage. It required a crew of 2,200 and could carry up to 250 troops.<ref name="DC" />

Despite their slow speed, their engines consumed high amounts of fuel, which somewhat limited the range of these vessels. The Neutron Star also required frequent and expensive maintenance to operate, making it quickly replaced by most organizations that could afford it.<ref name="RAS" />

===Cruiser carrier conversion===
{{Main|Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser carrier conversion}}

Technicans and mechanics of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] found the maintenance time and resources that the Neutron Star class vessels required problematic but the ship starved Alliance was unwilling to discard the vessels completely. Instead they converted some of the ships into carriers. This was done by converting Cargo storage areas into hangers for three squadrons of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], but also the modifications altered the design's armaments and crew requirements while upgrading both the primary and backup hyperdrives.<ref name="RAS" /> The unmodified models carried no fighters at all.<ref name="DC" />

==History==
Though produced during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], none of these ships saw service in that conflict, as the sudden [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] defeat made the [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] ships obsolete. The Empire had little interest in the outdated design and bought only a few for tests and for patrolling secure sectors. The majority were sold to private concerns.<ref name="TFUCG" />

These [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruisers]] were frequently used by [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] and [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] authorities as patrol vessels in poor systems and fringe worlds. Some of them were even used as armed freighters, but their poor performance and high maintenance cost put most of these ships out of commission.<ref name="TFUCG" />

Despite their flaws they were popular with forces that had limited budgets, and mercenary groups often attempted to purchase ships from planetary defense forces, then upgrade them to suit their needs.<ref name="DC" />

The Alliance to Restore the Republic deployed some of these vessels, but they often required escort to be effective. The class originally carried no [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement,<ref name="DC" /> but the Alliance converted a number of the ships into cruiser-carriers.<ref name="RAS" />

[[File:OmzesIncredibleTravelingStarport-PlattsStarportGuide.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The bulk cruiser ''Allanthia'', better known as ''[[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport]]''.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The standard depiction of the ''Neutron Star''-class design is based on the profile illustration in the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''. However, a very different depiction of the bulk cruiser appears in ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', in an illustration of the [[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|''Allanthia'']], which resembles an upscaled version of a Corellian [[Action series/Legends|Action series]] freighter.
